_about: Pass/fail thresholds for stage 4, written 2026-11-28 before run.py was first executed. Each check compares one key of results/<id>.json 'metrics' with max (value <= x), min (value >= x), abs_max (|value| <= x), range [lo, hi] or equals. Thresholds are never loosened to pass; a changed threshold keeps its old value and the reason under 'changes'. Predictions come from CHAMP's phase_generator.h and leg_controller.h (stance_duration 0.25 s, swing fixed at 0.25 s, offsets lf 0, rf 0.5, lh 0.5, rh 0) and from the speeds in docs/07 Task 3.3.

4.01.title: One footstep
4.01.basis: vx 0.1 m/s for 0.25 s: the has_swung_ rule holds all feet for 0.125 s, then rf and lh run the second half of their swing; lf and rh stay in stance

4.02.title: One gait cycle
4.02.basis: stride = stance 0.25 + swing 0.25 = 0.5 s, duty factor 0.5; phases relative to lf lift-off

4.03.title: Walk in place
4.03.basis: vx 0.001 m/s for 10 s: non-zero, so CHAMP steps, stroke 0.25 mm; 10 s / 0.5 s = 20 strides

4.04.title: Walk 0.5 m
4.04.basis: vx 0.2 m/s for 2.5 s, open loop; docs/07 measured 0.181 m/s steady at this command

4.05.title: Walk 1 m
4.05.basis: vx 0.2 m/s for 5 s, open loop

4.06.title: Walk backward
4.06.basis: vx -0.2 m/s for 2.5 s (0.5 m); docs/07 measured -0.260 m/s, 130 %

4.07.title: Walk sideways
4.07.basis: vy 0.2 m/s for 2.5 s (0.5 m to the left); docs/07 measured 0.214 m/s with -0.043 m/s forward creep

4.08.title: Walk diagonally
4.08.basis: vx = vy = 0.1414 m/s for 2.5 s: 0.5 m at 45 deg

4.09.title: Turn 45 deg
4.09.basis: wz 0.5 rad/s for pi/4 / 0.5 = 1.571 s; tolerance max(5 deg, 10 % of the turn)

4.12.title: Walk a curve
4.12.basis: vx 0.2 m/s, wz 0.3 rad/s for 5.236 s: a quarter circle of radius 0.667 m; deviation = distance from the circle

4.13.title: Accelerate and decelerate
4.13.basis: step vx 0 -> 0.3 m/s for 5 s -> 0; speed from ground truth over a 0.5 s (one stride) window; 10-90 % times

4.14.title: Different speeds
4.14.basis: vx 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30 m/s, 6 s each, steady speed over the last 4 s; docs/07 measured 63 % of the command at 0.1 m/s

4.15.title: Walk-trot transition
4.15.basis: a walk has lateral-sequence phases near 0.25/0.5/0.75 and duty factor above 0.5; a trot has diagonal pairs at 0 and 0.5 and duty factor 0.5. Passes only if the slow and fast steps of the 4.14 run show different patterns (lh phase differs by more than 0.15 or duty factor by more than 0.1)

4.16.title: Change step length
4.16.basis: stance_duration 0.25 -> 0.35 s (params/gait_stance035.yaml): stride period 0.5 -> 0.6 s, stroke 0.25 v -> 0.35 v, stride length v T up 20 % at equal speed; vx 0.2 m/s

4.17.title: Change foot clearance
4.17.basis: swing_height 0.04 -> 0.08 m (params/gait_swing008.yaml), vx 0.2 m/s; the foot cannot rise more than swing_height + stance_depth + 5 mm

4.18.title: Stop during locomotion
4.18.basis: projects/p02 measure_stop.py --zero: 0.3 m/s for 4 s, one zero twist; p02 measured 0.38 s, 0.04 m

4.19.title: Keyboard control
4.19.basis: p02 key_drive.py 'i 3, - 3, j 3, - 3' into teleop_twist_keyboard -> p02 safety_node.py -> /cmd_vel; 0.3 m/s x 3 s = 0.9 m, 0.5 rad/s x 3 s = 86 deg

4.20.title: Disconnect the publisher
4.20.basis: p02 safety_node.py dead-man 0.6 s, a_max 0.5 m/s^2: predicted 1.57 s, 0.31 m; without the node CHAMP keeps walking
